category_title: Students who display hostility toward diversity-related course content
minimal_context: The student is attending a class session where a presentation on Planned Parenthood and abortion is being shown.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For today's class session, we will be viewing a presentation on Planned Parenthood and abortion.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are we watching this? This content completely challenges my core values and beliefs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just watch the presentation for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Proclaiming in a public bullying display) I’m not going to listen to some bullshit liberal attitude about Planned Parenthood and abortion.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down and let the presentation continue.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! You are just a supporter of murderers!
